annotations.title: Tell the people who make Chorus what went wrong or was missing.

description: Sends a short note to the people who make Chorus. Call it when a tool fails or gives you something you did not expect, when the person asks for something no tool can do, or when a description here left you unsure what to call. Say what happened in your own words, and leave out names, email addresses, phone numbers and anything from the person’s messages. It changes nothing on any book and emails nobody.

book.description: The handle start_book gave you, when the note is about one book.

tool.description: The Chorus tool the note is about, when there is one.

trying_to.description: What the person wanted done, in a few words, for example order a second printed copy.

what_happened.description: What went wrong, what was missing or what was unclear, in a sentence or two.
